title: The Finance tab of an internal work order offers no payment or deposit actions
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, in status Approved, billable, so the usual actions can be compared.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open work order 2.
  4. Open the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows no discount and tax Settings button, no Add Deposit, no New Payment, no Issue Credit and no IBS action.

Step 3:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 4:

  • Work order 2's Finance tab shows its usual actions.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-N5: “"Add Deposit" is not shown on internal and no-charge work orders.”
  • S2-R4: “Lines on an internal or no-charge work order show quantity, cost (parts) and hours (labor) and no sell prices: the Rate, Margin and Total columns of the lines table (a part's sell price sits in Rate) and the Sell price, Rate and Margin fields of the line and part dialogs are hidden and not required; there is no work order total, tax, fee or discount block; the shop supplies block is the flat amount of Story 10. Cost is shown only to users with 'See Financial Data', as cost is today; other users see quantity and hours. The estimate and invoice documents for these work orders show the same and carry the NO CHARGE stamp and, on a no-charge work order, the line "Category: [Category]" under the stamp; the shop-floor Print Work Order is unchanged (it carries no prices today). Board cards and the statistics that show a work order total show "No Charge" in place of the amount.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 3667 (TP-535): “discount/tax Settings, Add Deposit, New Payment, Issue Credit, IBS hidden; Send to Portal per S2-R11; Customer PO optional”
  • Tech plan line 3357 (TP-457): “the discount/tax Settings button hidden on non-billable”
